name: js-async-pool
instruction: Implement asyncPool.js (CommonJS): module.exports = asyncPool. asyncPool(limit, items, fn) runs fn(item, index) over every item with AT MOST `limit` invocations in flight at once, and resolves to an array of results in INPUT order (not completion order). As soon as one call rejects, no further items may be started, and the returned promise rejects with that error. limit must be a positive integer or an Error is thrown. An empty items array resolves to [].
